s.note: Alva selling fish out of the old schoolhouse
s.how: Flake 150g smoked trout into 150g cream cheese with dill and lemon juice. Spread on 12 rye crispbreads and top with slices of pickled onion.

s.note: the Krums and the Ellingboes at each other's throats
s.how: Make 6 beef sliders from 300g mince with cheddar and pickles, and 6 pork sliders from 300g mince with grated apple and sage. Serve side by side in 12 slider buns so both families get their own.

m.note: the big cabin in the woods full of carved toys
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Add 2 onions, 3 carrots, 6 crushed juniper berries and 375ml stout. Simmer covered for 3 hours until it falls apart. Serve with 1kg potatoes mashed with butter.

w.how: Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 100g golden syrup. Stir in 300g flour, 2 tsp ginger and 1 tsp cinnamon. Chill, roll and cut into envelopes. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Pipe with white icing and add a red seal.

d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g dark chocolate and a pinch of cinnamon until frothy. Pour into four mugs and top with marshmallows. A true selfless act always sparks another.
